name: Teen Get-A-Way
description_short: Five week town travel camp, Monday to Thursday, for Bedford town and school district residents entering 7th to 10th grade, with a different trip each day; past trips include Dorney Park, Lake Compounce, Six Flags New England, baseball games, Broadway shows and fishing trips.
refund_policy_summary: 80% of camp fees are refunded on written request until May 31; no refunds after that. Medical refund requests need a doctor's note.
notes: Price shown is the school district resident rate; town residents pay $1,900.
